record.bible_text: Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Go down<WH03381><WTH8798> to the house<WH01004> of the king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, and speak<WH01696><WTH8765> there this word<WH01697>,

For if ye do<WH06213><WTH8799> this thing<WH01697> indeed<WH06213><WTH8800>, then shall there enter in<WH0935><WTH8804> by the gates<WH08179> of this house<WH01004> kings<WH04428> sitting<WH03427><WTH8802> upon the throne<WH03678> of David<WH01732>, riding<WH07392><WTH8802> in chariots<WH07393> and on horses<WH05483>, he, and his servants<WH05650>, and his people<WH05971>. <RF>upon...: Heb. for David upon his throne<Rf>

But if ye will not hear<WH08085><WTH8799> these words<WH01697>, I swear<WH07650><WTH8738> by myself, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, that this house<WH01004> shall become a desolation<WH02723>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> unto the king's<WH04428> house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063>; Thou <FI>art<Fi> Gilead<WH01568> unto me, <FI>and<Fi> the head<WH07218> of Lebanon<WH03844>: <FI>yet<Fi> surely I will make<WH07896><WTH8799> thee a wilderness<WH04057>, <FI>and<Fi> cities<WH05892> <FI>which<Fi> are not inhabited<WH03427><WTH8738><WTH8675><WH03427><WTH8737>.

And I will prepare<WH06942><WTH8765> destroyers<WH07843><WTH8688> against thee, every one<WH0376> with his weapons<WH03627>: and they shall cut down<WH03772><WTH8804> thy choice<WH04005> cedars<WH0730>, and cast<WH05307><WTH8689> <FI>them<Fi> into the fire<WH0784>.

And many<WH07227> nations<WH01471> shall pass<WH05674><WTH8804> by this city<WH05892>, and they shall say<WH0559><WTH8804> every man<WH0376> to his neighbour<WH07453>, Wherefore hath the LORD<WH03068> done<WH06213><WTH8804> thus unto this great<WH01419> city<WH05892>?

Then they shall answer<WH0559><WTH8804>, Because they have forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> the covenant<WH01285> of the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430>, and worshipped<WH07812><WTH8691> other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>, and served<WH05647><WTH8799> them.<CM>

Weep<WH01058><WTH8799> ye not for the dead<WH04191><WTH8801>, neither bemoan<WH05110><WTH8799> him: <FI>but<Fi> weep<WH01058><WTH8798> sore<WH01058><WTH8800> for him that goeth away<WH01980><WTH8802>: for he shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> no more, nor see<WH07200><WTH8804> his native<WH04138> country<WH0776>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> touching<WH0413> Shallum<WH07967> the son<WH01121> of Josiah<WH02977> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, which reigned<WH04427><WTH8802> instead of Josiah<WH02977> his father<WH01>, which went forth<WH03318><WTH8804> out of this place<WH04725>; He shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799> thither any more:
But he shall die<WH04191><WTH8799> in the place<WH04725> whither they have led him captive<WH01540><WTH8689>, and shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> this land<WH0776> no more.

Woe<WH01945> unto him that buildeth<WH01129><WTH8802> his house<WH01004> by<WH03808> unrighteousness<WH06664>, and his chambers<WH05944> by wrong<WH04941>; <FI>that<Fi> useth his neighbour's<WH07453> service<WH05647><WTH8799> without wages<WH02600>, and giveth<WH05414><WTH8799> him not for his work<WH06467>;

That saith<WH0559><WTH8802>, I will build<WH01129><WTH8799> me a wide<WH04060> house<WH01004> and large<WH07304><WTH8794> chambers<WH05944>, and cutteth him out<WH07167><WTH8804> windows<WH02474>; and <FI>it is<Fi> cieled<WH05603><WTH8803> with cedar<WH0730>, and painted<WH04886><WTH8800> with vermilion<WH08350>. <RF>large: Heb. through-aired<Rf> <RF>windows: or, my windows<Rf>

Shalt thou reign<WH04427><WTH8799>, because thou closest<WH08474><WTH8808> <FI>thyself<Fi> in cedar<WH0730>? did not thy father<WH01> eat<WH0398><WTH8804> and drink<WH08354><WTH8804>, and do<WH06213><WTH8804> judgment<WH04941> and justice<WH06666>, <FI> and<Fi> then <FI>it was<Fi> well<WH02896> with him?

He judged<WH01777><WTH8804> the cause<WH01779> of the poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>; then <FI>it was<Fi> well<WH02896> <FI>with him: was<Fi> not this to know<WH01847> me? saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.

But thine eyes<WH05869> and thine heart<WH03820> <FI>are<Fi> not but for thy covetousness<WH01215>, and for to shed<WH08210><WTH8800> innocent<WH05355> blood<WH01818>, and for oppression<WH06233>, and for violence<WH04835>, to do<WH06213><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> . <RF>violence: or, incursion<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> concerning Jehoiakim<WH03079> the son<WH01121> of Josiah<WH02977> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>; They shall not lament<WH05594><WTH8799> for him, <FI>saying<Fi> , Ah<WH01945> my brother<WH0251>! or, Ah<WH01945> sister<WH0269>! they shall not lament<WH05594><WTH8799> for him, <FI>saying<Fi> , Ah<WH01945> lord<WH0113>! or, Ah<WH01945> his glory<WH01935>!

He shall be buried<WH06912><WTH8735> with the burial<WH06900> of an ass<WH02543>, drawn<WH05498><WTH8800> and cast forth<WH07993><WTH8687> beyond<WH01973> the gates<WH08179> of Jerusalem<WH03389>.<CM>

Go up<WH05927><WTH8798> to Lebanon<WH03844>, and cry<WH06817><WTH8798>; and lift up<WH05414><WTH8798> thy voice<WH06963> in Bashan<WH01316>, and cry<WH06817><WTH8798> from the passages<WH05676>: for all thy lovers<WH0157><WTH8764> are destroyed<WH07665><WTH8738>.

I spake<WH01696><WTH8765> unto thee in thy prosperity<WH07962>; <FI>but<Fi> thou saidst<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will not hear<WH08085><WTH8799>. This <FI>hath been<Fi> thy manner<WH01870> from thy youth<WH05271>, that thou obeyedst<WH08085><WTH8804> not my voice<WH06963>. <RF>prosperity: Heb. prosperities<Rf>

The wind<WH07307> shall eat up<WH07462><WTH8799> all thy pastors<WH07462><WTH8802>, and thy lovers<WH0157><WTH8764> shall go<WH03212><WTH8799> into captivity<WH07628>: surely then shalt thou be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> and confounded<WH03637><WTH8738> for all thy wickedness<WH07451>.

O inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802> of Lebanon<WH03844>, that makest thy nest<WH07077><WTH8794> in the cedars<WH0730>, how gracious<WH02603><WTH8738> shalt thou be when pangs<WH02256> come<WH0935><WTH8800> upon thee, the pain<WH02427> as of a woman in travail<WH03205><WTH8802>! <RF>inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress<Rf>

<FI> As<Fi> I live<WH02416>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, though Coniah<WH03659> the son<WH01121> of Jehoiakim<WH03079> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063> were the signet<WH02368> upon my right<WH03225> hand<WH03027>, yet would I pluck<WH05423><WTH8799> thee thence;

And I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> thee into the hand<WH03027> of them that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> thy life<WH05315>, and into the hand<WH03027> <FI>of them<Fi> whose face<WH06440> thou fearest<WH03016><WTH8801>, even into the hand<WH03027> of Nebuchadrezzar<WH05019> king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894>, and into the hand<WH03027> of the Chaldeans<WH03778>.

And I will cast thee out<WH02904><WTH8689>, and thy mother<WH0517> that bare<WH03205><WTH8804> thee, into another<WH0312> country<WH0776>, where ye were not born<WH03205><WTH8795>; and there shall ye die<WH04191><WTH8799>.
But to the land<WH0776> whereunto they desire<WH05375><WTH8764><WTH8676><WH05315> to return<WH07725><WTH8800>, thither shall they not return<WH07725><WTH8799>. <RF>desire: Heb. lift up their mind<Rf>

<FI> Is<Fi> this man<WH0376> Coniah<WH03659> a despised<WH0959><WTH8737> broken<WH05310><WTH8803> idol<WH06089>? <FI>is he<Fi> a vessel<WH03627> wherein <FI>is<Fi> no pleasure<WH02656>? wherefore are they cast out<WH07993><WTH8717>, he and his seed<WH02233>, and are cast<WH02904><WTH8717> into a land<WH0776> which they know<WH03045><WTH8804> not?
O earth<WH0776>, earth<WH0776>, earth<WH0776>, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, Write<WH03789><WTH8798> ye this man<WH0376> childless<WH06185>, a man<WH01397> <FI>that<Fi> shall not prosper<WH06743><WTH8799> in his days<WH03117>: for no man<WH0376> of his seed<WH02233> shall prosper<WH06743><WTH8799>, sitting<WH03427><WTH8802> upon the throne<WH03678> of David<WH01732>, and ruling<WH04910><WTH8802> any more in Judah<WH03063>.<CM>
